data.title: 神裂火织 · 天草式剑道场的破晓沉思
data.description: 古朴清幽的和式剑道场内，清晨朝阳透过障子纸拉门切入。神裂双手合握修长木刀凝神卓立，闭目感受天地气流，修长健美的体态宛若出鞘神兵。
data.location: serene traditional Japanese wooden dojo hall with sliding shoji doors catching morning sun
data.action: standing in balanced martial stance holding heavy wooden bokken with both hands, eyes closed in deep meditative focus
data.lighting: 障子门透入的纯和晨曦明光
data.promptProse: Kaori Kanzaki holds a balanced martial stance with a wooden bokken inside a quiet morning dojo, eyes closed in profound meditative focus.
data.animaCaption: Morning sun through the shoji screens casts soft geometric shadows across her focused stance.
